thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered (INC1234567) — HTTP 5xx error-rate spike on inference-gateway-prod. Alert: 5xx_rate > 5% (3m). Assigned to: @eve_oncall. Link: https://pagerduty/INC1234567
eve_oncall: acking the page, on it. spinning up context... :eyes:
sam_sre: seeing same in metrics, spikes originate from edge -> gateway, us-west1. qps steady but 5xx trending up. noticing 502 and 504 predominately.
maria_eng: any recent gateway deploys? checking deploy bot...
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-03-14T21:02 rolled to 20% of inference-gateway ~10m ago.
leo_support: customers starting to file timeouts, one large tenant reporting repeated failures.
eve_oncall: acked. running quick curl against gateway, getting 502s for longer generation paths. sample attached:
```
curl -v https://inference.prod/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
* Connected to inference.prod
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
...
```
sam_sre: checking k8s, model-router pods show connection reset errors, kube-proxy logs show "connection refused" to model-router on several nodes. could be ephemeral port exhaustion or bad env.
eve_oncall: i'm going to remove canary traffic and pause rollout to stop widening blast radius. executing:
```
kubectl rollout pause deployment/inference-gateway -n prod
kubectl patch svc inference-gateway --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/selector/canary","value":"false"}]'
```
maria_eng: enabling fallback model pool and bumping model-router replicas while we investigate:
```
kubectl scale deploy/model-router -n prod --replicas=12
```
ops-bot: Autoscaling triggered for model-router: +6 replicas (total 12) at 21:07 UTC.
eve_oncall: updating PD incident: set priority P1 due to customer impact, paging CS.
leo_support: pinging affected customers with preliminary notice; no data loss reported, degrading availability.
sam_sre: after scale + remove canary, 5xx dropped 7.2% -> 1.3% in ~2m. latency still elevated, keeping watch.
eve_oncall: leaving incident open, monitor for 30m. will coordinate handoff if persists.
maria_eng: found a suspicious config in canary: CONNECTION_MAX=50 applied — likely upstream throttling. will prepare revert and stronger canary gating.
sam_sre: confirmed node-level kube-proxy flaps coincident with canary rollout. root cause likely combined: bad canary socket limit + transient kube-proxy instability.
eve_oncall: creating short mitigation checklist: 1) pause canary, 2) scale model-router, 3) revert CONNECTION_MAX in canary, 4) add deploy gating test for socket limits.
ops-bot: Incident INC1234567 state: acknowledged -> mitigated. current 5xx: 0.9%. Will auto-close if stable for 30m.
leo_support: drafting customer status update, will include ETA and impact summary.
maria_eng: opening PR to revert CONNECTION_MAX and add unit test to canary harness.
oncall_rotation: noted for handoff in ~25m, will assume monitoring if still open.
eve_oncall: nice work everyone :heart: i'll update the incident timeline and attach logs + graphs (kibana link, prometheus graphs). tagging action items for postmortem.
incident-bot: INC1234567 updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Please add notes to incident doc: https://incidents/internal/INC1234567
